description: This file defines a React functional component 'CompatibilityOverrides' used in a Next.js frontend application. The component provides a UI to allow users to manually override skills proficiency ratings, which then recalculates a compatibility score. It imports utilities and types from a scoring library, manages state with React hooks, and renders range sliders for user interaction.

methods.name: CompatibilityOverrides
methods.description: React component for overriding skill proficiencies and recalculating compatibility scores.
